asr_configuration.recommended_provider: Azure Speech SDK / OpenAI Whisper large-v3
asr_configuration.acoustic_model_notes: Trained on Philippine English accented diphthongs and Tagalog enclitic particles (po, opo, naman, pala, kasi).

tts_configuration.compromises: Code-switched Taglish sentences with technical English finance terms sometimes suffer from unnatural pitch shifts at language boundaries.

domain_terminology.rider: Karagdagang benepisyo o critical illness rider
domain_terminology.lapse: Pagkapaso o pagka-lapse ng polisa kung hindi nahulugan
domain_terminology.coverage: Kabuuang halaga ng proteksyon o sum insured
domain_terminology.bank_referral: Rekomendasyon mula sa branch manager ng bangko

cultural_tone_guidelines: Always maintain respectful warmth using 'po' and 'opo' regardless of caller's age.
Frame insurance around family love, legacy, and saving loved ones from sudden financial hardship (malasakit).
Never pressure or shame customer when discussing tight budgets or delayed payments.
If customer escalates or shows distress, NEVER switch abruptly to cold corporate English; stay in empathetic, calming Taglish.
